Chapter 1: Non-Communicable Diseases

Lung cancer and heart diseases

After the study of this chapter the students will be able to:

state the symptoms and causes of lung cancer.

state the protective measures for prevention of heart diseases.

Causes and symptoms of lung cancer

Cancer is the most dangerous and fatal of all diseases. This disease occurs through the uncontrolled division of some cells of the body. The body keeps the division of cells under control, so that new cells are produced only when they are needed. Because of a defect in this system the division of cells becomes uncontrolled. Through the uncontrolled division of cells a mass or lump is formed. This is called a tumour (Tumor).

When this tumour (Tumor) is very malignant, it is called cancer. This tumour can be removed so that it does not reach the remaining parts of the body. If it starts to grow, it mixes into the blood and reaches other parts of the body. The process of the spreading of the tumour (Tumor) is called metastasis (Metastasis). Lung cancer too is the result of metastasis (Metastasis). This cancer is fatal and dangerous to life.
